g.text: A Vite + React front page for SoF1. The server list is a text file baked into the bundle by a cron job, not a live API.
index.html · one root div, logs on load and DOMContentLoaded
main.tsx · QueryClient with focus refetch off, StrictMode, devtools
served from gh-pages · vite base is /sof-react/
api/serverlist.txt · imported as a raw text module at build time
css files · .transitions-on added only after the first click
App.tsx · fires the query, sets margin from the sidebar ref width
MenuButton.tsx · bars or X icon, owns the open flag
Sidebar.tsx · five li items, no router and no handlers
util.tsx · serverListToObject splits lines then backslashes
get_servers.yaml · cron every 20 min, wget, amend, push
gh-pages branch · dist plus .nojekyll, deployed by npm run deploy
reads the text once, cached for the session
refreshed by the cron job, never by the browser
